description: Project-owner-approved exact residuals: four existing records renewed through January 31, 2027 and eight separately approved CVE-2026-53615 records only through November 5, 2026. Resolved Expat is removed. Other findings, changed identities/severities, unused entries and expired acceptance fail closed; the 396-key baseline is unchanged. Publication requires separate authorization.

compensating_controls: TowerScout imports urllib3 2.8.0 from the application environment.
The publish workflow verifies the application and pip-private urllib3 versions before scanning.
The accepted record is limited to pip 26.2.2's private urllib3 2.7.0 package identity.
The comparator requires exact-image filesystem inventory and the matching Trivy embedded-SBOM package record; an extra or misplaced urllib3 copy fails closed.

The project owner reviews weekly under TASK-107 and immediately on an upstream fix, changed identity/severity, supported-path exposure change, or failed gate; January 31, 2027 is the expiry cap, not an automatic retention period.

The application does not invoke pip or install model dependencies automatically. Pip remains active during controlled HTTPS dependency installation; this is bounded acceptance, not a claim that pip is unreachable.
findings.reason: Trivy inventories pip's private vendored copy through pip's CycloneDX metadata; TowerScout's importable HTTP dependency is fixed at urllib3 2.8.0.

compensating_controls: Bounded supported-path review found no TowerScout disk-partition probing caller or raw-block-device mapping; standard Compose profiles do not enable privileged mode or SYS_ADMIN.
No block devices were present in isolated default CPU/CUDA containers. This is bounded exposure evidence, not proof of unexploitable code.
Retain Debian 12 and its required libraries; do not force-remove essential dependencies or mix Debian suites.
The project owner owns TASK-107 review weekly and immediately on a vendor fix, severity/identity change, new disk-probing caller, raw-device exposure, privileged/capability change, or failed gate.
Remove this exact exception when fixed and requalify affected images/packages. Acceptance expires November 5, 2026; no automatic extension or January renewal applies.
findings.reason: The project owner separately approved this exact eight-record CVE-2026-53615 exception on October 22, 2026 after paired-image scans and the Debian 13 assessment. Crafted DOS extended-partition input can falsify libblkid partition metadata; no supported application caller was identified and no Bookworm vendor fix was available. This is temporary risk acceptance, not remediation.
